title: Server trust accepted from the challenge without evaluation in swift — review required
description: A URLSession authentication challenge is answered with a credential built directly from challenge.serverTrust. The trust object has not been evaluated by the app, so any certificate chain is accepted, including one an on-path attacker generated. The rule flags the credential construction; whether a separate evaluation precedes it is a review decision.
remediation: Evaluate the trust with SecTrustEvaluateWithError and complete the challenge only when the result is trusted.
limitation: Lexical: matches the credential construction; a prior explicit evaluation in the same method is not linked.

tests.line: # audit: let credential = URLCredential(trust: challenge.serverTrust!) present
# verified: guard SecTrustEvaluateWithError(challenge.serverTrust!, nil) else { completionHandler(.cancelAuthenticationChallenge, nil); return }
